( 02 )
The structure

How it works.

Sunday morning is a ritual. Show up, train, connect, go home a better dad. That's the whole thing.

01

Arrive

Show up 5–10 minutes before 6:00am at Wellington Reserve Playground carpark, 36–42 Mackie Road, Mulgrave. Parking is easy — no fuss.

02

Train

Outdoor group session — scalable for all fitness levels. Strength, movement, conditioning. No egos, no yelling. Just good blokes doing the work.

03

Connect

Walk over to Mackie Road Cafe for a relaxed chat until around 7:30am. Talk life, business, fatherhood, or just enjoy the quiet company.

04

Go

Home & present before 8:00am. More energised, clear-headed, and ready to be the dad your family deserves — before most of the world is awake.

( 03 )
The philosophy

Why this works.

You want to drop weight and rebuild consistency. You feel stretched thin between business and family. You're done feeling 'half there' with your kids. One solid Sunday session anchors your entire week.

This isn't a performance club. It's not a sales funnel. The session is sacred — no pitch, no upsell, no asterisk. These workouts will always be free. If you ever want deeper support, I offer coaching separately. But on Sundays, it's just about showing up.

Community — Free, always

Join Sunday

No membership. No commitment. Just show up this Sunday and train with a crew of founder-dads who are done sleepwalking. All you need is the willingness to be present.
